ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark-gray) to 30% high-intensity (white/light-gray). High-intensity pixels are concentrated on the distal regions and outer trailing edges, while low-intensity pixels dominate the central peduncle attachment and inner lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black mass centered at the peduncle and extending into the mid-lobes. High-contrast white mottling and salt-and-pepper patterns are localized on the outer 25% of both the left and right lobes, with a distinct transitional gradient of gray pixels between the solid black and white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 75-80 degrees and a relatively shallow vertical depth relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous boundary. The left lobe exhibits more frequent, sharper peaks (approx. 3-8 pixel amplitude), while the right lobe shows several larger, blunt-trapezoidal protrusions interspersed with smaller valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curves sweeping from the peduncle to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-angled corners at the lateral extremes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, circular calcified structures (barnacles) are visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Several isolated circular 'ring' scars (approx. 5-12 pixels in diameter) are detectable on the inner light-colored region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional linear pixel disruptions. Visible parallel rake marks (set of 4-5 lines) on the upper-right lobe and numerous unaligned diagonal scratches across the white-pigmented areas of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge shows signficant wear and irregular jaggedness consistent with previous minor trauma or barnacle detachment; no major amputations or catastrophic tissue loss is visible.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, isolated dark circular ring-mark is visible in the lower-central region of the left lobe pigmentation.
